vehicle: 2027 ZR1X 3LZ Coupe, Torch Red (GKZ), Carbon Fiber Aero Package (TOM/FEJ), visible carbon roof (C2Z), 20-spoke Carbon Flash forged wheels (SOG), dark Alcon J59 calipers, Jet Black interior (HTE)

roof.name: Visible Carbon Fiber removable roof panel

aero.name: ZR1 Carbon Fiber Aero Package / ZTK Track Performance

wheels.name: 20-spoke Carbon Flash-painted forged aluminum (20x10 F, 21x13 R)

options: Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 R ZP (ZTK)

brakes.name: Alcon 10-piston front / 6-piston rear monobloc calipers (dark finish w/ white CORVETTE/alcon lettering), 16.5-inch (420 mm) carbon-ceramic rotors F/R

cabin.name: Jet Black 3LZ (redesigned 3-screen curved cockpit: 6.6" left aux + 14" cluster + 12.7" right infotainment, carbon ZR1X wheel)

powertrain.layout: Mid-rear ICE + Front e-AWD electric drive unit (through-the-road hybrid, 1,250 hp combined)

transmission.family: Tremec TR-9080 8-speed wet dual-clutch transaxle w/ eLSD
transmission.note: MLP is hybridized ZR1X variant; non-hybrid ZR1 is M1K

battery.chemistry: Li-ion (80 cells, 8 vertical modules in structural center tunnel)

resolution_limits: Chevrolet official 30-frame 360° flipbook (view-00..view-29) is native maximum 1500x750 PNG on both chevrolet.com and chevrolet.ca (probing ?imwidth=3000 returns byte-identical 1500x750).

Chevrolet dynamic CGI endpoint (cgi.chevrolet.com/mmgprod-us/dynres/prove/image.gen) serves native maximum 2500x1407 JPEG (preset gmds11; gmds10=1920x1080, gmds20..29=960x540, gmds12..19=480x270) across 7 fixed studio angles v=deg01..deg07 (deg08+ return HTTP 404). All 7 matching-config renders are included as view-30..view-36.

reference_3d_model.title: 2025 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1
reference_3d_model.author: Ddiaz Design
reference_3d_model.use: reference-only (benchmark proportions/surfaces against high-res photos; do not copy divergences)
divergences_vs_2027_zr1x: Old 2025 C8 2-screen 'wall of buttons' interior vs 2027 3-screen curved dash
Top-shell-only engine plenum; lacks full LT7 block/turbos, 8-speed DCT/gears, front EDU, tunnel battery, exhaust routing, SLA suspension
Monolithic material-grouped meshes; no separable hinged doors/hood/hatch/roof
10-spoke carbon wheels vs 20-spoke Carbon Flash forged wheels (SOG)
Tan 6-piston Brembo ZR1 calipers vs dark 10-piston F / 6-piston R Alcon J59 calipers
ZR1 side badges & white plate vs ZR1X dark badges & silver CHEVROLET plate
Black carbon mirror caps vs Torch Red upper mirror caps w/ black base
4 protruding black underbody aero strakes below sill (absent from 2027 360° street profile)
reference_3d_model.usage: Initial camera-calibration proxy and visual reference. The exported ZR1X body uses the project’s Chevrolet-photo reconstruction.

remaining_gaps: No photographic teardown of the internal single-speed reduction gear teeth inside the sealed HP1 front electric drive unit (covered externally by 1724x1058 front render, 1734x1106 X-ray, 2572x1032 rear-3/4, and 1071x656 ZR1X plan view; internal EDU gear teeth are spec-inferred).

No ZR1X-specific MLP DCT internal photograph distinct from the shared C8 Tremec TR-9080 architecture (covered by official GM/TREMEC 1342x970 TR-9080 cutaway, 800x432 isolated geartrain, 1722x1248 rear-3/4, and 740x480 front-3/4 & bottom CAD).
